claims.exact_statement: For every genuine Boolean q and existing coordinate x, let r=chi_x q and T_x(q)=A(r), with only the selector fresh. Character multiplication is an involution, so the images over arbitrary q are exactly all ordinary activations A(r), and their restriction closure contains every Boolean function. The complete L_{c,eta} surcharge is equation (8) of PROOF.md. The direct half-contraction L(T_x(q))<=L(q)/2 fails for every c>0 at q=chi_x, where the residual is c/2.

x is an existing physical input of q
